subject: Y1
name: Trumbull: sunlit Gothic stone hall under a pale blue sky

styleSelection.reason: Painted value planes carry the form: broad pale stone and sky washes, shaped mid planes on dry paper, one cross-boundary shadow glaze, dark window recesses last, selective closing ink on the hard edges the picture shows.

families.referenceCue: Pale cerulean-to-ultramarine sky with soft white cloud lights at upper right and between the gable and the right tower; one connected graded wash laid as overlapping lanes on dry paper, hard edge only where it meets the roof and tower silhouettes.
Slim yellow-green street tree against pale stone, with olive and sap-green bushes at the lower left: one irregular mass with olive darks on the shadow side, crisp leaf edges, trunk last.

Coursed ochre and honey stone: one broad pale connected plane per wall with paper showing through, cream string courses and copings kept light; the left tower and left wing in cooler brown-grey shade with one connected shadow glaze across wall, window and roof edge; blue-grey slate roofs as flat cool planes with crisp edges; deep navy window panes in pale stone frames and pointed arches as the last dry, crisp dark accents.

reserves.reason: brightest cloud at upper right, kept as bare paper
white lower banner pole, bare paper
